proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A REPORT ON USE OF CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECKS IN HIRING DECISIONS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating the use of criminal background checks in hiring and employment decisions and the risk of racial discrimination resulting from them.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD RECOMMENDS THAT YOU VOTE "AGAINST" THIS PROPOSAL REGARDING A REPORT ON USE OF CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECKS IN HIRING DECISIONS.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING SUSTAINABILITY AS AN EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION PERFORMANCE MEASURE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Compensation Committee include sustainability, covering environmental and social considerations, as a performance measure for senior executives under incentive plans.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD RECOMMENDS THAT YOU VOTE "AGAINST" THIS PROPOSAL REGARDING SUSTAINABILITY AS AN EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION PERFORMANCE MEASURE.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING VOTE-COUNTING PRACTICES FOR SHAREHOLDER PROPOSALS
proposals.proponent: Investor Voice, SPC, on behalf of Bryce A. Mathern
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend governing documents so non-binding shareholder proposals are decided by a simple majority of votes cast FOR and AGAINST, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD RECOMMENDS THAT YOU VOTE "AGAINST" THIS PROPOSAL REGARDING VOTE-COUNTING PRACTICES FOR SHAREHOLDER PROPOSALS.
